## Question
> How does this repository's git storage work end to end? Cover how HEAD, the refs, the index, and the object store fit together to produce README.md in the working tree.

## Your Exploration Angle
Trace how README.md is materialized and checked in the working tree. Inspect the actual file, status/diff plumbing, file mode and hashes, and repository configuration that affects checkout if relevant. Explain conceptually what clone/checkout/read-tree/checkout-index do while keeping this investigation read-only. Emphasize the transition from indexed blob to filesystem bytes and how later edits are detected.

## Output

### Components Found
The key types, services, classes, and abstractions. For each: name, file path, and a one-sentence description of what it does.

### Flow
The execution flow step by step. For each step: what command/storage lookup runs, what file it's in, what it does, what it calls or resolves next. Include the data that flows between steps.

### Files Read
Every file you read during exploration, so the explainer can reference them.

### Boundaries
Where this subsystem connects to other parts of the repository. The inputs and outputs.

### Non-Obvious Things
Anything surprising, historically motivated, or easy to get wrong. Things that look like they should work one way but work another.

### Open Questions
Anything you couldn't fully trace or understand. Be honest about gaps.
</user_query>
I'll trace how `README.md` moves from the index blob into the working tree, staying strictly read-only and leaving refs, the index, and objects untouched.

input.command: ls -la && echo "---- GIT DIR ----" && if [ -d .git ]; then ls -la .git; echo "---- HEAD ----"; cat .git/HEAD; echo "---- CONFIG ----"; cat .git/config; elif [ -f .git ]; then echo "gitfile:"; cat .git; fi; echo "---- README STAT ----"; ls -la README.md 2>/dev/null; file README.md 2>/dev/null; echo "---- ENV ----"; git --version; git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree --git-dir --show-toplevel 2>&1
input.description: Inspect repo root, git dir, README

content.text: The repo is a single-file working tree. Next I’ll follow `README.md` from `HEAD` through the ref, commit, tree, index, and on-disk bytes.

input.command:
export GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0
echo "===== REV-PARSE ====="
git rev-parse HEAD
git rev-parse --verify HEAD^{commit}
git rev-parse --symbolic-full-name HEAD
echo "===== CAT-FILE COMMIT ====="
git cat-file -p HEAD
echo "===== CAT-FILE -t each object ====="
git cat-file --batch-check --batch-all-objects
echo "===== LS-TREE ====="
git ls-tree -l HEAD
echo "===== LS-FILES ====="
git ls-files -s -v --debug --stage README.md
echo "===== HASH-OBJECT worktree (no -w) ====="
git hash-object README.md
echo "===== STAT ====="
stat -f "mode=%OLp size=%z mtime=%m atime=%a ctime=%c birth=%B inode=%i flags=%f" README.md
echo "===== XATTR ====="
xattr -l README.md || true
echo "===== STATUS (locks off) ====="
git status --porcelain=v2 --branch --untracked-files=all
echo "===== DIFF ====="
git diff --raw -- README.md
git diff --cached --raw -- README.md
git diff-files -p -- README.md
git diff-index HEAD -- README.md
echo "===== CONFIG EFFECTIVE ====="
git config --show-origin --get-regexp 'core\.(filemode|bare|ignorecase|precomposeunicode|symlinks|autocrlf|eol|sparsecheckout|protectNTFS|protectHFS|quotePath|safecrlf|longpaths)'
echo "===== CHECK-ATTR / SPARSE ====="
git check-attr -a -- README.md || true
ls -la .git/info .git/refs .git/refs/heads .git/objects .git/objects/pack .git/objects/info 2>&1 || true
echo "===== NO PACK / NO ALTERNATES ====="
find .git/objects -type f -o -type l | sort
echo "===== INDEX HEADER HEX ====="
xxd .git/index | head -40
echo "===== INDEX SIZE ====="
wc -c .git/index README.md
echo "===== OBJECT TYPES via cat-file ====="
for o in $(find .git/objects -type f | sed 's|.git/objects/||;s|/||'); do
  echo -n "$o "
  git cat-file -t "$o"
  echo "----- $o -----"
  git cat-file -p "$o"
done
input.description: Trace README from HEAD through index
